overlap.comparison: For a standard tetrahedron with every λ_i<1/3, it gives the same vertex-side caps, normalized area vectors, unique balanced weights and mean. Its affine change of coordinates extends this part to all tetrahedra, while the present theorem also covers general d and the cutoff boundary, and provides the exact individual availability criterion outside the central region.

In the central region it gives the same edge determinant expression as the ordinary halfspace minimum, with the minimizing labels precisely those of largest λ_i. It does not give the actual centroid balance weights, mean, or individual availability criterion at general interior marks.
